title: TikTok 运营关键词
html:
TikTok 运营关键词

概述

本章聚焦 TikTok 运营场景，分为平台核心概念、内容类型、广告与投放、TikTok Shop 四个部分。它提供海外短视频平台特有的英语词汇，覆盖账号运营、内容分发和商业变现等环节。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适用于平台业务沟通与文档。建议先掌握平台核心概念，再学习广告投放和电商相关的术语。

平台核心概念

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
For You Page (FYP) n. 推荐页 appear on FYP, FYP algorithm
creator n. 创作者 content creator, creator economy
duet n./v. 合拍 duet a video, duet feature
stitch n./v. 拼接 stitch a clip, stitch feature
sound n. 音频/音乐 trending sound, original sound
effect n. 特效 AR effect, trending effect

听说例句

A: How do we get our content on the FYP? B: Focus on the first 2 seconds, use trending sounds, and encourage duets to boost engagement.

A: Should we create our own original sound? B: Yes, branded sounds can go viral. We can also stitch popular creators' content for more visibility.

写作表达

  • The For You Page algorithm prioritizes content with high engagement signals such as shares, comments, and completion rate.
  • Leveraging the duet and stitch features enables brands to participate in trending conversations organically.

内容类型

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
UGC (User-Generated Content) n. 用户生成内容 UGC campaign, encourage UGC
branded content n. 品牌内容 branded content partnership, branded video
tutorial n. 教程 how-to tutorial, step-by-step tutorial
challenge n. 挑战赛 hashtag challenge, launch a challenge
behind-the-scenes n./adj. 幕后花絮 BTS content, share behind-the-scenes
unboxing n. 开箱 unboxing video, product unboxing

听说例句

A: What type of content performs best on TikTok? B: UGC and tutorials consistently do well. We should also launch a hashtag challenge for the new product.

A: Should we do unboxing videos? B: Definitely. Unboxings and behind-the-scenes content feel authentic and drive high engagement.

写作表达

  • The hashtag challenge generated over 2 million UGC videos within the first week of launch.
  • Branded content partnerships with top creators delivered 3x higher engagement than traditional ads.

广告与投放

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
In-Feed Ad n. 信息流广告 in-feed ad placement, in-feed video ad
TopView n. 开屏广告 TopView ad, TopView campaign
Spark Ads n. 原生加热广告 boost with Spark Ads, Spark Ad format
CPM n. 千次展示成本 average CPM, lower CPM
CPC n. 点击成本 CPC bid, reduce CPC
ROAS n. 广告支出回报率 target ROAS, improve ROAS

听说例句

A: What's our ROAS for the current campaign? B: 4.2x on Spark Ads, but in-feed ads are underperforming. We should optimize the creative.

A: Should we try TopView for the product launch? B: It's expensive — high CPM — but it guarantees massive reach on day one.

写作表达

  • Spark Ads delivered the highest ROAS among all ad formats, outperforming in-feed ads by 60%.
  • Optimizing creative assets reduced our average CPC by 25% while maintaining consistent conversion rates.

TikTok Shop

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
TikTok Shop n. TikTok电商 set up TikTok Shop, TikTok Shop seller
affiliate n./adj. 联盟推广 affiliate program, affiliate commission
showcase n. 商品橱窗 product showcase, add to showcase
live shopping n. 直播购物 live shopping event, host live shopping
product link n. 商品链接 pin product link, click product link
sample n. 样品 send samples, sample request

听说例句

A: How do we onboard creators for the affiliate program? B: We send free samples and offer a 15% commission. Creators add our products to their showcase.

A: Is live shopping working for us on TikTok Shop? B: Yes, our last live shopping event generated $50K in GMV. Product links had a 10% click-through rate.

写作表达

  • The TikTok Shop affiliate program has onboarded over 500 creators, driving 30% of total sales.
  • Live shopping events combined with pinned product links have proven to be the most effective conversion channel on the platform.
